subject: Security acceptance checklist and DPA retention — MAP (ClearGate)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@cleargate.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security acceptance checklist and DPA retention — MAP (ClearGate)

Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Per follow-up, I've attached a draft MAP outline with the proposed acceptance checkpoints focused on the security/compliance items that matter for your procurement and legal teams. High level ask: confirm the minimum evidence set ClearGate will accept for an initial onramp so we can commit to a close window.

Key items called out in the MAP_v1_outline.pdf (attached):
- SOC 2: which Trust Services Criteria you want in-scope for acceptance (we recommend Security + Availability as a baseline for hosted evaluation)
- SIG / CAIQ snapshot: we can provide a populated CAIQ + control mappings; please confirm any vendor-specific questions you want highlighted
- DPA: redline path and timing — if you require a negotiated DPA we'll need a DocuSign/trackable link and a target sign date to hit the MAP cadence
- Data retention: proposed defaults and carveouts (see section 3) — we recommend a default 90-day ephemeral KV cache + 365-day customer logs retention for evaluation, with longer-term archival options available under Dedicated/Private plans

Open questions from our side that will affect the close timeline:
1) Does ClearGate require SOC 2 Type II reports or will an in-progress Type II (controls in place + evidence) suffice for an evaluation POC?
2) Are there any CAIQ sections you consider blockers (e.g., crypto key custody, data residency) that we should prioritize?
3) What is your procurement target date for contract signature?

Attachments: MAP_v1_outline.pdf (outline and milestone calendar)

Next steps: if you can confirm answers to the bullets above by EOD Thursday (17 Jul) we'll produce a consolidated MAP (final) and a shorter acceptance checklist for your security reviewers.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Sam Wells <sam.wells@cleargate.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@cleargate.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist and DPA retention — MAP (ClearGate)

Thanks, Naomi — appreciated. Quick answers and a couple of clarifications: 

- SOC 2: for procurement we'd prefer Type II, but for a pilot we're willing to accept a recent Type I plus an evidence snapshot for key controls (audit trail, access control, incident response). We will need the Type II within the first 90 days of production if we move beyond POC.
- CAIQ: data residency and key management (who holds keys for customer data in transit and at rest) are must-address items. If you can provide a CAIQ with crypto/key custody notes, that will speed our security review.
- DPA: procurement will need the redline — can you send a DocuSign link? We aim to complete contract review by 31 Jul.
- Retention: for evaluation we're okay with what you proposed, but legal will ask for a clear statement about minimum retention and deletion proof. Our default is to push for 7 years for some logs for auditability, but we indicated we could scope that down to only specific logs retained longer — can we include a retention carveout table in the DPA appendix?

We can get you precise answers on the retention carveouts by Thursday. For timeline: target contract signature 31 Jul, POC start 5 Aug (two-week POC), production decision end of September.

Sam
Sam Wells

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security acceptance checklist and DPA retention — MAP (ClearGate)

Looping in a proposed internal acceptance checklist based on Sam's reply. I'm attaching a SOC2 evidence index we maintain — it maps artifacts to control objectives so we can hand ClearGate exactly what's needed for a Type I + evidence snapshot and the later Type II.

Proposed acceptance checklist (short):
- Provide CAIQ + control mapping (we'll flag key management section and include our KMS integration notes)
- Hand over SOC 2 Type I report and evidence bundle (evidence index attached)
- Deliver DPA draft via DocuSign; include a retention appendix that lists: default evaluation retention (90d cache, 365d logs), optional archival tiers, and named carveouts for audit logs (specify max 7y on per-case basis)
- Define acceptance sign-off owners: Security reviewer (ClearGate), Legal (ClearGate), Redwood AE/CS (Naomi)

Attachments: soc2_evidence_index.xlsx (artifact list + control mappings)

If we're aligned, I can populate the CAIQ with the key custody notes and prepare the DocuSign-ready DPA redline for Naomi to send to Sam. Sending timeline: CAIQ + DPA draft ready by Fri 18 Jul.

— Karthik

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Sam / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity on the Type II expectation for production. Per Karthik's note, next steps and owners below (pulling together the MAP final):

1) CAIQ + key custody notes — owner: Karthik (deliverable: CAIQ_populated_ClearGate.xlsx) — ETA: Fri 18 Jul (sent to your security reviewers same day)
2) DPA redline (DocuSign ready) — owner: Naomi/Legal (attachment: MAP_Naomi_Sam_20250715.pdf with DPA appendix) — ETA: Mon 21 Jul (we will send DocuSign link once redline is complete)
3) SOC 2 evidence snapshot + index — owner: Karthik (soc2_evidence_index.xlsx attached in thread) — ETA: Fri 18 Jul
4) Retention appendix — owner: Redwood Legal + ClearGate Legal (we will include a carveout table allowing a limited set of audit logs to be retained up to 7 years by exception; default retention stays as discussed)

Target dates to preserve your stated procurement cadence:
- DPA sent for signature: by Mon 21 Jul
- Contract signature target: 31 Jul
- POC start: 5 Aug

If those dates change on your side, let me know immediately so we can adjust the MAP calendar. I've attached the consolidated MAP with the acceptance checklist (MAP_Naomi_Sam_20250715.pdf).

Attachments: MAP_Naomi_Sam_20250715.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.
